title: Acute haemoglobin decline and ST-segment depression: analysis code
description: Analysis code, locked protocols and aggregate results for a pre-registered, two-centre, within-patient electrocardiographic study of acute haemoglobin decline and ST-segment depression (HEEDB / MGH discovery; MIMIC-IV / BIDMC external validation). No patient data are included.
